To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
teen motherhood is a legacy of disadvantage.

1) the majority of the teen mothers in the study had experienced disadvantage before they gave birth to a child; 2) the teen mothers who experienced disadvantage before they had a child had a greater likelihood of experiencing further disadvantage after they had a child; and 3) the teen mothers in our study were more likely to experience disadvantage in the form of low educational attainment than in the form of poverty.
teen motherhood is not a random event and that teen mothers are not a random sample of the population.
